errors.evidence: The 2015 paper “Pie Menus or Linear Menus, Which Is Better?” is authored by Pietro Murano and Iram N. Khan (formatted as “Pietro Murano” and “Iram N. Khan). Preliminary investigation using ResearchGate and DBLP indicates that both authors had previously published work before this paper.
errors.description: The agent misinterpreted the tool output by assuming that both authors had previously published work before the 2015 paper, which led to an incorrect final answer.
